gates.question: What exact Lean revision and platform artifacts will Anneal execute?
gates.blocking_condition: The proposed Lean release, archive bytes, or platform mapping cannot be pinned immutably.
minimum_evidence: Resolve the Lean release/tag to an immutable revision.
Record every consumed platform archive and content digest.
Record the exact Anneal configuration change selecting the release.

gates.question: Do Anneal and Aeneas intentionally select the same Lean/Lake proof environment?
gates.blocking_condition: Anneal's Lean toolchain differs from Aeneas' generated-code expectation without a reviewed compatibility argument.
minimum_evidence: Read Aeneas backends/lean/lean-toolchain.
Read Anneal's independently selected Lean version and archive hashes.
Record any intentional divergence explicitly rather than inferring compatibility from adjacent versions.

gates.question: Which Mathlib and transitive Lake package revisions accompany the new Lean release?
gates.blocking_condition: The generated/proof project is checked against an unreviewed dependency closure or an unlocked resolution result.
minimum_evidence: Record Aeneas' exact lake-manifest.json closure, including Mathlib.
Diff package revisions and source kinds against the current baseline.
Materialize/load the locked dependency tree using the new Lean/Lake toolchain.

gates.question: Did the logical trust/admission boundary change?
gates.blocking_condition: A proof relied on by Anneal gains unexpected axioms/admissions or bypasses ordinary kernel checking.
minimum_evidence: Revalidate axiom/sorry/unsafe and kernel-checking behavior relevant to Anneal.
For representative final theorems, compare transitive axiom dependencies with the accepted allowlist.
Audit any changed options or execution path that can skip ordinary checking.

gates.question: Does Aeneas-generated Lean retain the syntax, elaboration, module, and name-resolution behavior Anneal relies on?
gates.blocking_condition: Previously accepted generated code or annotations require unreviewed syntax/elaboration/name-resolution changes.
minimum_evidence: Elaborate a fixed generated-Lean corpus under the exact proposed toolchain and dependency closure.
Diff diagnostics and any source-level edits required for acceptance.
Review parser/elaborator, module/import, and name-resolution changes implicated by failures.

gates.question: Did proof automation used by generated or user-authored proofs change materially?
gates.blocking_condition: The new toolchain changes proof success, failure, or dependency behavior in a way Anneal has not reviewed.
minimum_evidence: Run representative proofs using simp/simp_all and any relied-on linter behavior.
Exercise grind and omega where Anneal or its proof library relies on them.
Treat proof-search success and failure as revision-sensitive; preserve proof terms/axiom dependencies rather than relying on tactic names alone.

gates.question: Did recursive-definition, partiality, or termination syntax/semantics change?
gates.blocking_condition: A translated or user-authored recursive definition changes totality assumptions or fails under the proposed Lean grammar/elaborator.
minimum_evidence: Revalidate structural and well-founded termination paths used by the corpus.
Recheck partial/partial_fixpoint behavior and Aeneas-generated termination suffixes.
Run representative recursive and loop-generated Lean examples.

gates.question: Can existing or prepared .olean/.ilean/Lake state be reused safely after the upgrade?
gates.blocking_condition: Anneal reuses build artifacts without establishing compatibility and freshness for the exact new toolchain.
minimum_evidence: Treat .olean as revision/build-sensitive native serialized state, not a portable interchange format.
Revalidate Lean Git/toolchain identity, Lake traces/hashes, module invalidation, and import-path resolution.
Prefer a clean rebuild unless a preserved cache-seeded equivalence probe establishes safe reuse for the exact artifact classes.

gates.question: Did batch diagnostics, LSP/RPC tactic-state querying, or incremental invalidation behavior change?
gates.blocking_condition: Interactive or diagnostic consumers interpret stale state, changed coordinates/protocols, or changed severity/success semantics as equivalent behavior.
minimum_evidence: Replay a preserved batch JSON diagnostic specimen and compare schema/severity/range behavior.
Replay tactic-state-at-position and edit/invalidation protocol transcripts against the proposed server.
Verify document-version, dependency-staleness, reconnect, and processing-barrier behavior used by Anneal tooling.

gates.question: Are Lean/Lake native artifacts and the packaged toolchain valid on every supported host class?
gates.blocking_condition: Prepared native artifacts or helper binaries are reused across incompatible platform/toolchain boundaries, or archive relocation/linking fails.
minimum_evidence: Inspect the exact release archive on each supported platform class.
Revalidate retained native objects/libraries/executables separately from .olean/.ilean artifacts.
Exercise the relocated/read-only packaged environment rather than only a development checkout.

gates.question: Does the new Lean/Lake environment satisfy any determinism or cache-reuse property Anneal actually depends on?
gates.blocking_condition: Anneal relies on byte identity or clean/cache-seeded equivalence that has not been demonstrated for the proposed toolchain.
minimum_evidence: Run repeated clean builds when byte identity matters and hash the exact artifact classes consumed by Anneal.
Run clean versus cache-seeded comparisons when prepared-cache equivalence matters.
Do not promote source-level determinism mechanisms into a whole-build reproducibility claim without execution evidence.

gates.question: Does the proposed Lean release preserve Anneal's actual generated-code-to-proof integration?
gates.blocking_condition: Component checks pass but the exact packaged Rust→LLBC→Aeneas Lean→proof path fails or changes proof-relevant behavior unexpectedly.
minimum_evidence: Run a compact generated-Lean corpus covering ordinary functions, borrows, loops/recursion, models/traits, diagnostics, and expected failures.
Use the exact packaged Lean/Lake environment and dependency closure Anneal will ship.
Require successful elaboration where expected and compare representative theorem axiom sets and diagnostics.
